### Feature Description

What feature would you like to see in the package?

### Why Is This Needed?

### Suggested API / Implementation

If you have an idea of how this should look, share a code sketch.

```php
// e.g. proposed facade method, attribute, contract, config key, or command signature
```

### Alternatives Considered

Are there workarounds you've tried (custom formatters, custom subscribers, manual gcloud calls, etc.), or alternative approaches you've ruled out?

### Backwards Compatibility

Would this change break existing API surface (facade methods, contracts, attributes, events, config keys, queue driver behavior)?

### Additional Context

Add any relevant links (Google Cloud Pub/Sub docs, CloudEvents spec, related Laravel features), references, or related issues.
